name: coverage-legal_dms
objective: Coverage recette for the legal_dms domain: the privileged role legal_admin exercises every one of its 10 catalogued actions, asserting the documented posture (1 allow, 8 escalate, 1 deny). Proves the catalog/engine emit the right verdict for each action of this domain.
teaching: The legal_admin gets a verdict matching the risk, never a blanket grant: a low-risk routine action is allowed (least-privilege), a sensitive action escalates to a human (I6), a pure-deny action stays denied for everyone. The whole sweep is replayable for audit (I4).
